nodes.label: guidance/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Sets __version__ 0.3.2, imports library/models, re-exports the decorator, and swaps in the _Guidance ModuleType so `guidance(...)` is callable.

nodes.label: _guidance.py
nodes.desc: def guidance() at L17 wraps functions; GuidanceFunction L44 binds Model args and caches dedented templates; GuidanceMethod L80 handles call styles.

nodes.label: Tool schema
nodes.desc: FunctionTool and Tool Pydantic models (L77) describing callable tools that gen(tools=...) can emit mid-generation.

nodes.label: library/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Aggregates the 30+ public guidance functions into __all__, from gen and select to media helpers like image and gen_audio.

nodes.label: gen()
nodes.desc: gen() at L13: constrained sampling with name capture, max_tokens, regex, stop/stop_regex, temperature, and tool calls; regex() at L155.

nodes.label: role()/system()/user()/assistant()
nodes.desc: role() at L8 plus system() L16, user() L32, assistant() L48 return context managers that push Block openers/closers while active.

nodes.label: guidance.json()
nodes.desc: json() at L13 compiles a JSON Schema (or Pydantic model) into a JsonNode so emitted text is schema-valid by construction.

nodes.label: sequence helpers
nodes.desc: one_or_more() L22, zero_or_more() L27, sequence() L16, and repeat-count helpers for building repetition structure in grammars.

nodes.label: block()
nodes.desc: block() at L16 and the Block class at L8 provide the opener/closer bookkeeping that role managers are built on.

nodes.label: _grammar.py builders
nodes.desc: string() L19, regex() L23, gen() L27, select() L61, repeat() L117, token_limit() L141, with_temperature() L156, capture() L175, subgrammar() L182.

nodes.label: ASTNode tree
nodes.desc: Function L99, ASTNode L150, GrammarNode L208; leaves LiteralNode L317, RegexNode L361, SelectNode L369, JoinNode L397, RepeatNode L420, RuleNode L464, SubgrammarNode L544, JsonNode L568.

nodes.label: TokenParser/ByteParser
nodes.desc: TokenParser L27 consumes token bytes; ByteParser L197 implements match() for offline grammar validation and forced-token fast-forwarding.

nodes.label: Model
nodes.desc: Model L58: __add__ L100 copies state then _apply_node L115 walks the AST, stream() L157, __str__ L212, __getitem__ L223 for captures.

nodes.label: ModelStream
nodes.desc: ModelStream L330 delays execution; iterating it yields Model copies pushed onto context event queues as states evolve.

nodes.label: Interpreter (base)
nodes.desc: Interpreter L32 is the Generic[S] protocol mapping ASTNode input to OutputAttr yields; UnsupportedNodeError L107 marks missing backend features.

nodes.label: State (base)
nodes.desc: State ABC at L14 and CaptureVar typing define how interpreter state snapshots travel with each copied Model.

nodes.label: Engine
nodes.desc: Engine ABC L38 owns the tokenizer pair and runs the constrained-decoding loop that yields token-level OutputAttr events.

nodes.label: EngineInterpreter
nodes.desc: EngineInterpreter L16 turns each GrammarNode into engine calls; also Llama3Vision L158 and Phi3Vision L175 multimodal variants.

nodes.label: EngineState
nodes.desc: EngineState L7 tracks committed bytes and active grammar rules so parsing resumes correctly across Model copies.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.desc: Tokenizer L26 abstracts byte-token mapping; ByteTokenizerWrappable keeps encode/decode symmetric for the parser.

nodes.label: models/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Exports LlamaCpp, Mock, Model, OnnxRuntimeGenAI, OpenAI, Transformers and the two Azure factory helpers in __all__.

nodes.label: Transformers
nodes.desc: TransformersEngine L345 runs local HF models; Transformers L581 is the Model wrapper with TransformersTokenizer L58 byte handling.

nodes.label: LlamaCpp
nodes.desc: LlamaCppEngine L78 drives llama.cpp GGUF models; LlamaCpp L239 is the Model wrapper with its own tokenizer adapter L61.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.desc: OpenAIInterpreter L15 maps grammar rules to structured-output constraints; OpenAI L34 supports sync, async, and Azure-flavoured clients.

nodes.label: Mock
nodes.desc: MockEngine L66 replays canned bytes through the full grammar machinery; Mock L165 with ByteTrie L192 enables no-API testing.

nodes.label: Azure AI factories
nodes.desc: create_azure_openai_model L76 and create_azure_aifoundry_model L220 build Azure-configured OpenAI-compatible Model instances.

nodes.label: registry
nodes.desc: Context-scoped singletons: get_trace_handler L61, get_renderer L71, set_renderer L82, plus monitor and background async accessors.

nodes.label: TraceHandler
nodes.desc: TraceNode L242 records each input/output attribute; TraceHandler L332 maintains the execution tree that the UI renders.

nodes.label: Renderers
nodes.desc: Renderer base L68; JupyterWidgetRenderer L276 streams the interactive widget, AutoRenderer L586 picks the right one at import time.

nodes.label: TopicExchange
nodes.desc: TopicExchange L16 publishes GuidanceMessage traffic (TraceMessage, MetricMessage) between the model loop and the UI client.
